questions.q: Robinson's father came from which country?
questions.explain: Robinson's father was a foreigner from Bremen who later settled in Hull.

questions.q: What was Robinson's occupation after his father's death?
questions.explain: After his father's death, Robinson continued to merchandise, as he had before.

questions.q: Who was killed at the battle near Dunkirk?
questions.explain: Colonel Lockhart commanded the regiment that was killed at the battle near Dunkirk.

questions.q: What family did Robinson Crusoe's father come from originally?
questions.explain: Robinson Crusoe's father came from Bremen originally.

questions.q: What did Robinson Crusoe's father initially do for a living?
questions.explain: Robinson Crusoe's father initially did merchandise for a living.

questions.q: Where did Robinson Crusoe's father settle after he left his trade?
questions.explain: Robinson Crusoe's father settled in York after leaving his trade.
